{{Otheruses|Arbiter}}
{{Quote|On all matters you speak with my voice and authority.|Shae Vizla on the role of Arbiter|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>}}
'''Arbiter''' was a high-ranking position among the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> [[Mandalore the Avenger]] promoted [[Jekiah Ordo]] to the role of Arbiter to serve as the leader of the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] in her absence, while she hunted for the Mandalorian rebels known as the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
